summary: Specifies the IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) protocol for sending traffic flow information from an exporting process to a collecting process. It defines how data and template records are carried, so the data format is described with it. It was replaced by RFC 7011.

eli5.summary: Routers count what traffic passes through them and send summary reports to a collector. IPFIX is the format and way of delivering those reports. It was replaced by RFC 7011.

questions: how are ip flow records exported
